caveat: This checks pixel masks against visible GitHub artifacts only; it does not prove global uniqueness or any score-to-file attribution.

comparison.candidate_mask: finite candidate values greater than zero, restricted to the candidate footprint
comparison.equal_mass_mask: top 18,524 finite positive prior values within the candidate footprint; ties broken by ascending flat pixel index
comparison.grid_rule: Only one-band rasters matching candidate height, width, CRS, and full GDAL geotransform were compared.
comparison.jaccard: intersection size divided by union size; computed separately for prior positive support and equal-mass mask
comparison.method: positive-support and equal-mass top-18,524 mask comparison on exact common grid

non_comparable_artifacts.reason: Same dimensions, CRS, and 100 m cell size as the candidate, but a different origin/geotransform; excluded from exact-grid mask comparison.
Tiny 32 by 48 format-test grid with a different origin; excluded from exact-grid mask comparison.

comparison.prior_support_mask: finite prior values greater than zero, restricted to the same candidate footprint

inventory.source: GitHub tree/blob API one-time inventory; repositories under buffedlizard55-lab

limitations: This is a bounded search of public TIFF paths visible in repositories owned by buffedlizard55-lab at the observation date, not a global search.
The inventory recorded branch names and Git blob SHA-1 values, but not branch commit IDs; repository paths or branches may change over time.
Two blobs were read but excluded because their grids did not match exactly; reasons and observed grids are listed above.
The comparison measures binary positive support, not raster-value equality, geological validity, label quality, or score.
No public participant leaderboard row was mapped to any artifact or upload receipt by this audit.

A uniqueness result does not promote H47-B; its diagnostic screen against the known-fault catalogue-mask proxy failed, and this proxy is not the hidden missing-fault target; the TIFF is not for submission.
title: H47-B visible-artifact uniqueness screen
